description: rewrite the entries to the field renames, drops and folder moves their kinds declare. A kind file keeps a renamed field's old name (`renamed: {old: new}`) and a dropped one (`dropped: [...]`); an entry that holds one is `needs-migration`. Renames every old name (in entries, list parts and `sets`) and keeps current the agreements and built lines it only renamed; a kind that absorbed several (`was: [...]`) takes their entries, refusing two of one area and id; removes dropped fields and prints each value removed, leaving that entry's agreement so the owner sees the change. A kind that moved out of a fixed folder (`moved_from`) has its entries and removed items there moved to the area shared of its first layer, every address renamed; `move` each to the area that uses it. Records nothing. One atomic write.

description: add or change entries: one or many records in one checked, atomic write. A record is a mapping: `address` (or `kind`, `layer`, `area`, `id`) and the fields of the entry; an address that exists is changed (`field: null` removes a field), a new one is added. The records are JSON or YAML (a mapping, or an array of them), as arguments, from --file (- is standard input), or both. The batch is checked together: a decision and the entries its options set may come in one call. Nothing is written when any record is refused.
